metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully changed GIMP theme from Dark to Light by navigating Edit > Preferences > Interface > Theme and selecting Light, then clicking OK.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open GIMP preferences via Edit menu, navigate Interface > Theme section, select a theme from the list, and confirm with OK.
metadata.task_rationale: Same navigation pattern as original but targets a different theme (Gray instead of Light), testing generalization of the demonstrated preference-changing capability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GIMP theme to Gray via Preferences > Interface > Theme. Evaluator quits GIMP to flush gimprc, then checks config file for theme key set to Gray.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads gimprc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc via get_gimp_config_file
Postconfig correctly quits GIMP (Ctrl+Q) before reading config to ensure gimprc is flushed to disk
Metric check_config_status correctly parses gimprc line format '(theme "Gray")' by stripping parens, splitting by whitespace, and comparing key/value
Expected value '"Gray"' (with quotes) matches the quoted format stored in gimprc, so comparison will succeed
Full instruction coverage: single requirement (theme = Gray) is completely verified by the evaluator
Minor cosmetic issue: rules dict has 'type:' (with colon) instead of 'type', but check_config_status only reads 'key' and 'value' so this has no functional impact
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix typo in rules: change '"type:"' to '"type"' for consistency, though this does not affect evaluation correctness
